description: This file contains test cases written with pytest for a Python project involving project initialization templates, specifically for a Qwik-based web application. It tests the functionalities of template processing, project setup, configuration loading, and post-processing execution.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Creates and cleans up a temporary directory for tests.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Sets up a mock template directory with configuration and template files for testing Qwik project templates.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Creates a sample ProjectConfig instance representing a Qwik project.

methods.name: test_qwik_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies that template initialization info is correctly retrieved, including commands for environment setup.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests the entire project initialization process, including folder structure and content replacement.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Checks that post-processing scripts are executed and completed successfully.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Validates the ability to load project configuration from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Ensures template variable placeholders are correctly replaced with project configuration values.
